citation: [Arthur Meeker residence showing the front and one side with yard], 1815 South Prairie Avenue. Chicago Daily News staff photographer, 1908. Chicago Daily News negative DN-0005529, Chicago History Museum.
author: Chicago Daily News staff photographer
repository: Chicago History Museum, Chicago Daily News negatives collection (DN-0005529); catalogued on Explore Chicago Collections.
locator: The whole negative, as catalogued: the front and one side of the house with its yard.
rights_note: The Chicago Daily News negatives of 1902-1933 are offered by the Chicago History Museum and the Library of Congress without known restrictions (cdn_dn0003324_field_residence), but this negative's own record has not been read, and no copy is held.
access_notes: NOT SEEN. On 2026-11-21 (T-3562) its catalogue page refused this runner (403, a browser challenge) and the Library of Congress's copy of the collection was behind the same challenge; the title, date and number are as a web search gave the Chicago Collections record. Not in the image store.
note: The nearest dated picture of 1815 Prairie to 1904, and the only one known after the 1902 sale: the photographs the build follows are undated and show Joseph Sears's house. Whether its front is the photographed one or Heun's remodel settles which front stood in 1904 if, as the Ryerson and Burnham index says, the remodel was done in 1902.
what_it_supplies: (once seen) the front the Meekers' house showed in 1908
what_it_does_not_supply: anything yet: the picture has not been seen
